user_priority: PUSH失败→真实退避→完整收臂成功率，而不是单条演示或扩大WM训练
end_to_end_success_requires: No reset/task physical state write or FIFO clear
Observed real unloading and measured retreat
Actual load-bearing support capture before full protected stow
Preserve original failed/protectively-aborted PUSH outcome and goal/history

phases.name: CPU_and_preflight
phases.scope: Actual200Hz current and full5x18 proposals/immutable queue prefix; warn screens are not certified dynamics bounds

phases.name: one_known_development_pilot
phases.scope: Exactly ONE newly frozen pilot; no retry/autofill. Conservative early protection may precede contact and must be reported as such, NOT an immovable-box recovery success.

phases.name: development_regression
phases.scope: Only oldTRAIN3/4/5known conditions, failures retained; do not tune using exposed test conditions. New budgets/versions required.

phases.name: sealed_reliability_acceptance
phases.scope: New prospectively registered supported mass/friction/offset/yaw/initialvelocity/delay/contact domains; independent fresh seeds, source frozen before tests; no test-driven tuning or replacement episodes.

unsupported_case_policy: Record precondition rejection/hard censor as non-success in end-to-end tally; never call skipped/censored/early-abort-before-contact a successful failed-PUSH recovery.
